sections.label: The opening
sections.para: A reply to the post sharing DJB Strategies' publisher outlook: its framework as a template, answered for this newsroom; agreement on what to invest in, and one step further, the agent as a reader who pays.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: The argument; our own answers; the template; agreement; the agent as reader; the meter; leverage versus business.

sections.label: What the post says
sections.para: From search risk to agentic risk; AI cutting publishers out of the click; a 2029 base case of 5 to 10% delegated briefings; invest in what AI cannot replace, direct channels and crawler controls.

sections.label: We have not read the report
sections.line: We have not read the report
sections.para: It sits behind a registration form, so we answered from the post and the framework without seeing their answers; ours are our own.

sections.label: The framework as a template
sections.para: Four inputs, five output areas and four choices: the right questions, answered rather than argued with.

sections.label: Our answers
sections.para: A voice and a record; first-hand work; a static site on its own domain; agents under standards; sourced analysis; pages, summaries, graphs, versions, llms.txt and an API; direct channels; a per-read meter; a small team.

sections.label: Where we go further: the agent is a reader
sections.line: Where we go further: the agent is a reader
sections.para: Give the agent structure, claims, sources and a way to cite; invest in the record, defend provenance, reduce dependencies, build the machine-readable layer and the meter.

sections.label: What we agree on
sections.para: The weakening value exchange, investing in what AI cannot replace, direct channels and mapping exposure by intent.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: Report unread; we are small; agent payments a plan; the 5 to 10% is the report's; my interest.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: Vincent Peyrègne's post and framework image, from the editor's screenshots, quoted word for word.
